☆☆☆ 言情小说独家制作 ☆☆☆
一晃眼，婚后的生活已经过了大半年，但与其说杜天海和佟映晨是对夫妻，还不如说他们是住在同一个屋檐下、和平共处的两个“同居人”。
基本上这半年来他们俩的生活依旧没有太多交集，互动也不多。除了他想到就会去逗她一下，把她害得脸红心跳以外，即使两人同时待在家中，多数也是分处于两个空间里各自行动，譬如一个人在书房上网、一个人在客厅里看电视，或者一个人已经上床睡觉、另一个还没回家……总之是以互不干扰对方的作息为原则，凡事自己看着办，相安无事地过生活。
这天晚上，佟映晨站在瓦斯炉前准各晚餐，手里拿着汤杓，脑子还一边想着公司的事情……
“你在煮什么？”一道低沉的声音突然拂过她的耳畔，吓得她浑身一震，手里的杓子都飞了——
“小心！”他眼明手快地接住落下的汤杓，一手搂住她，没造成任何人与物的损伤。
“干么一声不响的吓人呀？！”她抢回杓子，惊魂未定地看着他，完全没料到他会在这时间回来。
平时他回家的时间通常都会比她晚上几个小时，可是现在才七点多而已。
“我哪有！是你自己不知道在想什么想得这么入神，才会没听到我的脚步声，连我回来了都不知道。”他明明有正大光明的开门、关门再走到厨房里，她干么说得他好像是从门外飘进来的一样。
看她这样听而未闻，他才担心哪天有小偷溜进来把家里搬光她都浑然不觉咧！
“那…你也不必靠我那么近讲话，远远的说就行了。”她摸摸自己的耳朵，觉得有人贴在她耳边说话的感觉好怪。
“那是你的敏感带？”他暖昧地微笑，摆明是在调戏良家妇女。
她没好气地一瞟，不理会这种轻浮的问题，转过身去继续煮晚餐，相处愈久觉得这男人讲话真是没几句正经的。
“刚刚在想什么？难道是在想我吗？”他却故意凑到她身边，搭着她的肩，在她耳边问话。不知为什么就是特别喜欢在这个一脸“正气”的女人身上挑起一点小小的涟漪，看她被逗得又羞又恼的模样便觉得很有趣。
“对啊。”她缩了下脖子，出人意料地承认。
“真的？！”他没想到自己的魅力已经影响她到这等程度！莫非她已经开始对他放感情了？
“嗯。”她把面条下进锅里，调整炉火，再抬头问他：“我今天汇了一笔钱给你，有收到吧？”
“有。”他点头，心想她怎么突然转移话题。
“那就好，我刚才还在想下午就应该先打电话给你确认一下，虽然现在能还你的数目不多，不过等公司的运作慢慢上了轨道后，我会再视情况调整金额。目前我还有几笔货款没收回来，今天已经跟其中一家厂商谈过……”她滔滔不绝地说着刚才脑袋里想的事情，顺便将公司目前的运作情形大致报告给他这个债务人知道，好让他不必担心钱会拿不回来。
原来这就是所谓的“想他”呀……

杜天海的嘴角微微抽动，收回搭在她肩上的手，再次从她身上感受到男性魅力的挫败。况且他才刚从公司回来而已，现在又有种踏进另一家公司的感觉，真是愈听愈想打哈欠……
现在轮到他想转移话题了！
“哇，好香……这煮得差不多了吧？”他打断她的话，俯身闻着锅上那阵热腾腾的香气。
“嗯，可以了。”她捞起面条检查，立刻关上炉火，差点就煮过头了。
“OK，你去拿碗筷，我来把它端上桌。”他自动自发地帮忙，觉得这锅汤面还比她的还款计划更令他感兴趣。
“嗯……”她面露犹豫地叫住他。
“怎么了？”
“因为你没说你要回来吃，所以我煮得不多。”她很诚实地告诉他，而且那只是她随便煮来填饱肚子的晚餐，可能也不合他的胃口。
“别担心，我只吃几口就好，不会害你饿肚子的。”他又故意开她玩笑，把她说得像个舍不得与人分享食物的小器鬼，但其实他待会儿本来就和朋友有约，出了门自然有东西吃。
“我又不是那个意思。”她睇着他道。
“快把碗拿来。”他照样没在理她，自顾自地把面端上餐桌。
盛好面后，他立刻趁热吃了一口。
“不赖嘛……没想到你还挺会煮面的。”他称赞她的手艺，觉得这碗面真是超乎他想像的美味。
“真的？”她才没想到他会吃得惯这么普通的味道。
“嗯，味道超丰富……这叫什么？”他再喝了一口热汤，迫不及待地想知道这道佳肴的名称，以前从没吃过。
“……总汇什锦面。”她有点心虚地说道。看他吃得那么开心，实在不好意思跟他说那碗面只是用前一天没吃完的几盘剩菜，加上一点新鲜豆腐、青菜所烹煮而成，连名字也是她瞎掰的。
“真的很好吃。”他却信以为真，还以为这是一道没尝过的平民料理，吃得津津有味，不知不觉中已经超过了好几口……
“吃慢一点，很烫。”她不怕他吃，倒怕他烫伤，尽管他大口吃面的样子还让她觉得满有成就感的……
经过这段时日的相处，她发现杜天海也不完全是个惹人厌的男人，虽然他经常说些令她翻白眼的话、花边新闻一箩筐、个性猖狂又有点不按牌理行事，好像自以为世界是绕着他在转。但同样的，他这个人也随兴自然、幽默风趣，因为热爱自由，所以也给她相对的空间，借了她一大笔钱却从没给她半点还钱的压力……
实说，如果别把他当丈夫看的话，他其实还算是个很好相处的男人。她想以现在的关系，他们俩应该可以和睦共处到这段婚姻倒数完毕那一天，到时候合作愉快地一拍两散。

第2章(2)
她细嚼面条，不自觉地望着他吃面的样子微微笑，也看到了他胸口那条镶着一颗钻石，造型别致的白金项炼。
“你的项炼看起来很特别。”她随口说道，觉得他似乎很喜欢那条项炼，从他们认识至今从未见他取下来过，是他身上唯一不变的配饰。
他忽然动作一顿，握住那枚闪耀的钻石……
“这是一份很特别的礼物，它对我意义重大。’毡口同被遮蔽的钻石光芒，他原本炯亮的眸中也浮掠过一抹黯淡。
“是你未婚妻送的？”她脱口说道，黯然的眸光立即扫向她——
“你连这件事也查了？”他面色微愠，马上猜到她是从何得知此事。哼，那些征信社还调查得真仔细……
“对不起。”刚才话一出口，她就想到自己不该在他面前提起这段伤心事。
“对不起什么！你究竟查到了多少有关她的事？”他神色一变，像被触动某个隐形的开关，突然引爆一阵冲天怒火，直烧向她。
佟映晨一时怔然，完全没想到他会发这么大的脾气。
“我……我只知道你曾有个未婚妻，她在四年前的一场意外中不幸丧生了。”她据实以告，面带歉意地告诉他自己只知道这么多。当初若不是为了替公司寻求出路，她也无意探查他人隐私，更不晓得提起这件事会让他这么生气。
“这些就够了！到此为止，以后别再找人调查我和她的事，也不准你在我面前提起她，否则我会重新考虑我们之间的协议。”他厉声警告，放下筷子便愤而离席，那个藏在他内心深处的秘密，谁也不许靠近！
content_en:
☆☆☆ Exclusive production of romance novels ☆☆☆
In a blink of an eye, more than half a year of married life has passed, but instead of saying that Du Tianhai and Tong Yingchen are a couple, it is better to say that they are two "cohabitants" living under the same roof and coexisting peacefully.
Basically, in the past six months, their lives still haven't intersected much, and they haven't interacted much. Except for the fact that he would tease her a little when he thought of it, making her blush and make her heart beat. Even if the two of them stayed at home at the same time, most of them would act separately in two separate spaces. For example, one person would surf the Internet in the study room, while the other would watch TV in the living room, or one person would go to bed and the other person would not go home... In short, the principle of not interfering with each other's work and rest would be the principle. They would take care of everything and live peacefully together.
That night, Tong Yingchen stood in front of the gas stove preparing for dinner, holding a ladle of soup in his hand and thinking about the company...
"What are you cooking?" A deep voice suddenly brushed her ears, frightening her whole body, and the ladle in her hand flew away——
"Be careful!" He quickly caught the fallen soup ladle and hugged her with one hand, without causing any damage to anyone or anything.
"Why are you so silent and scary?!" She snatched the ladle back and looked at him in shock, not expecting that he would come back at this time.
He usually comes home a few hours later than she does, but it's only after seven o'clock now.
"How could I not! You didn't know what you were thinking, and you were so absorbed in it that you didn't hear my footsteps and didn't even know I was back." He obviously opened and closed the door openly and then walked into the kitchen. Why did she say it as if he had drifted in from outside the door.
Seeing that she didn't hear anything, he was worried that someday a thief would sneak in and move the house without her even noticing!
"Then...you don't have to talk so close to me, just talk from a distance." She touched her ear and felt that it felt strange to have someone talking next to her ear.
"Is that your sensitive zone?" He smiled warmly, clearly teasing a decent woman.
She glanced angrily, ignored the frivolous question, and turned around to continue cooking dinner. The longer we got together, she realized that this man really didn't speak a few serious words.
"What were you thinking about just now? Are you thinking about me?" But he deliberately came to her side, put his arm around her shoulders, and asked in her ear. I don't know why, but I just like to stir up little ripples in this "upright" woman. It's very interesting to see how embarrassed and annoyed she is.
"Yes." She shrank her neck and admitted unexpectedly.
"Really?!" He didn't expect that his charm would affect her to this extent! Could it be that she has started to have feelings for him?
"Yes." She put the noodles into the pot, adjusted the fire, then raised her head and asked him: "I wired a sum of money to you today, did you receive it?"
"Yes." He nodded, wondering why she suddenly changed the subject.
"That's good. I was just thinking that I should call you to confirm in the afternoon. Although the amount I can pay you back is not much now, I will adjust the amount according to the situation when the company's operations slowly get back on track. I still have a few payments that have not been recovered, and I have talked to one of the manufacturers today..." She kept talking about what was on her mind just now, and by the way, she gave him a general report on the company's current operations to the debtor, so that he would not have to worry about not getting the money back.
It turns out that this is what is called "missing him"...
The corner of Du Tianhai's mouth twitched slightly, and he took back the hand on her shoulder, feeling the frustration of masculine charm from her again. Besides, he has just come back from the company, and now he feels like he has stepped into another company. The more he listens to it, the more he wants to yawn...
Now it's his turn to change the subject!
"Wow, it smells so good... Is it almost cooked?" He interrupted her and leaned over to smell it.Enjoy the hot aroma on the pot.
"Well, it's ready." She picked up the noodles and checked them, then immediately turned off the fire, almost overcooking them.
"OK, you go get the bowls and chopsticks, and I'll put it on the table." He helped automatically, feeling that the pot of noodle soup was more interesting to him than her repayment plan.
"Hmm..." She called him hesitantly.
"What's wrong?"
"Because you didn't say you were coming back to eat, I didn't cook much." She told him honestly, and it was just a dinner she cooked casually to fill her stomach, and it might not be to his liking.
"Don't worry, I'll just take a few bites, I won't make you hungry." He deliberately made fun of her, making her look like a little bitch who was reluctant to share food with others, but in fact, he had an appointment with friends later, so he would naturally have something to eat when he left the house.
"That's not what I meant." She looked at him and said.
"Bring the bowl quickly." He still ignored her and put the noodles on the table.
After serving the noodles, he immediately took a bite while it was hot.
"Not bad... I didn't expect you to be quite good at cooking noodles." He praised her cooking skills and felt that this bowl of noodles was really delicious beyond his imagination.
"Really?" She didn't expect that he would be used to such an ordinary taste.
"Well, it tastes super rich...what is this called?" He took another sip of the hot soup, eager to know the name of this delicacy. He had never tasted it before.
"...Zonghui Assorted Noodles." She said a little guiltily. Seeing that he was eating so happily, she was really embarrassed to tell him that the bowl of noodles was just made from a few plates of leftovers that were not finished the day before, plus a little fresh tofu and green vegetables. She even made up the name.
"It's really delicious." But he believed it, thinking it was a civilian dish he had never tasted before. He ate it with gusto, and unknowingly, he had eaten several bites...
"Eat slowly, it's very hot." She was not afraid of him eating, but she was afraid that he would be burned. Although the way he ate the noodles made her feel a sense of accomplishment...
After getting along with him for a while, she discovered that Du Tianhai was not entirely an annoying man, although he often said things that made her roll her eyes, had a lot of gossip, had a rampant personality, and acted a little irrationally, as if he thought the world revolved around him. But at the same time, he is also casual and humorous. Because he loves freedom, he also gives her relative space. He lent her a large amount of money but never put any pressure on her to repay the money...
To be honest, if you don't regard him as a husband, he is actually a very easy man to get along with. She thought that with their current relationship, the two of them should be able to live together harmoniously until the day the marriage comes to an end, and then they can happily break up.
Chapter 2(2)
She chewed the noodles carefully and smiled unconsciously at the way he was eating the noodles. She also saw the unique platinum necklace with a diamond on his chest.
"Your necklace looks very special." She said casually, feeling that he seemed to like that necklace very much. He had never seen him take it off since they met. It was the only constant accessory on his body.
He suddenly made a move and held the shining diamond...
"This is a very special gift, it means a lot to me." With the diamond light blocked by the felt mouth, there was also a hint of darkness in his originally bright eyes.
"Is it a gift from your fiancée? "She blurted out, and her gloomy eyes immediately glanced at her——
"Have you even investigated this matter? "He looked slightly stunned, and immediately guessed where she learned about this matter. Humph, those credit reporting agencies investigated so carefully...
"I'm sorry. "As soon as the words came out of her mouth, she thought that she shouldn't mention this sad incident in front of him.
"I'm sorry for what! How much did you find out about her? "His expression changed, as if an invisible switch had been touched, suddenly detonating a burst of sky-high anger, burning directly at her.
Tong Yingchen was stunned for a moment, completely unaware ofTo think that he would lose such a temper.
"I...I only know that you once had a fiancée who unfortunately died in an accident four years ago." She told the truth and told him apologetically that she only knew so much. If she hadn't been looking for a way out for the company, she wouldn't have had any intention of inquiring into other people's privacy, and she didn't know that mentioning it would make him so angry.
"That's enough! Until now, don't ask anyone to investigate her and me in the future, and you are not allowed to mention her in front of me, otherwise I will reconsider our agreement." He warned sternly, put down his chopsticks and left the table angrily. No one was allowed to get close to the secret hidden deep in his heart!
